method.pcm: Float32 before WAV quantization; signal peak is sample peak, not reconstructed true peak
method.spectrum: 16384-point four-term Blackman-Harris FFT; sum power within +/-5 bins of each expected in-band harmonic; residual excludes bins 0..5
method.offHarmonicDb: 10 log10(residual / harmonic energy). Alias proxy only for stationary periodic fixtures without modulation or noise; not a universal alias meter. Aliases landing inside harmonic masks are unobservable.
method.tuning: Interpolated rising zero crossings on a steady sine; cents = 1200 log2(measured/expected)
method.envelope: Constant unity input through actual scheduled gain vs independently evaluated piecewise linear reference at every sample
method.clicks: Maximum step in envelope error residual; zero-decay sustain step is intentional legacy behavior
method.cost: Offline wall milliseconds including context setup; median of 5 measured runs after warm-up; informational only, no real-time CPU claim
method.repeatability: Maximum and RMS PCM difference between equivalent independently constructed offline graphs in the same browser process

deferred.reason: record baseline first; harmonic residual has masking blind spots and browser band-limiting differs
relative 4x-vs-none gate applies to specified high sine fixture only; compare native reconstruction filters when SYN-007 exists
virtualized offline timings cannot establish desktop/mobile callback deadlines or underruns
live/offline share scheduler; hardware loopback capture is still required

references.use: automation ordering, oversampling latency and offline rendering contracts
window leakage, spectral resolution and power-ratio methodology

gateRationale.envelope: 3e-5 absolute gain error allows floating-point and sub-sample scheduling variation; measured maximum at baseline is below 1e-6; no perceptual click-free claim for the intentional zero-decay step
gateRationale.tuning: 0.3 cents is a conservative numerical tuning regression budget, not a hearing threshold
gateRationale.signalLevels: DC/peak/RMS and silence thresholds detect basic waveform/path regressions; they are not mastering or true-peak qualification
gateRationale.drive: 6 dB relative alias-proxy improvement is a conservative regression budget below the observed 21-50 dB on the specified fixtures; -25 dB on the production route fixtures guards gross loss of oversampling
gateRationale.referenceIdentity: Stored steady spectra use 5% plus 1e-4 absolute amplitude tolerance and 10% plus 2e-4 absolute harmonic power-ratio tolerance; timings are excluded from comparisons
